item.title: House passes SAVE America Act, fueling debate over citizenship requirements
item.description: A fierce debate over the integrity of the U.S. electoral system is intensifying following the House’s narrow passage of the SAVE America Act.The legislation, which would mandate proof of U.S. citizenship for voter registration and require photo ID at the polls, faces an uncertain future in the Senate.
